objective: Candidate rotates a pizza in its horizontal plane; PR-2036 raises and pivots a desktop monitor from landscape to portrait.
physical_skill: Candidate uses a long thin tool for under-edge traction in a roofed oven; PR-2036 uses direct bimanual manipulation of articulated height and pivot joints while preventing desk strikes and base motion.
success_condition: Candidate requires a released 150–210° pizza yaw with continuous support and limited translation. PR-2036 requires the released monitor within portrait, height, tilt, swivel, stability, and base-position tolerances.
reason: The monitor task tests articulation manipulation and base stabilization, not frictional in-plane rotation of a loose supported object through an inserted tool.
